content: Benchmark: a benchmark method from the literature. In the case of Wikipedia, this is BIBREF5 , who use structural features and readability scores as features to build a random forest classifier; for arXiv, this is BIBREF2 , who use hand-crafted features, such as the number of references and TF-IDF weighted bag-of-words in abstract, to build a classifier based on the best of logistic regression, multi-layer perception, and AdaBoost.
